# Chest tier list — Style Prompt

> A ranking reel over one continuous talking-head take. A dark S-to-F tier table sits on the speaker's chest; a skewed, glowing orange title in two short lines floats above the head; small white captions sit just under the chin. Each thing the speaker names pops up as a big ringed card over the table, and on the verdict it drops into its tier row in a third of a second, the row flashing as it lands. The table fills up beat by beat and ends as the payoff: the finished ranking.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

1. **Pop on the name, drop on the verdict.** An item never appears before it is named and never lands before it is judged. If name and verdict come together, drop 1 s after the pop.
2. **The table is a scoreboard that only fills.** Items stay in their rows to the end; same-tier items line up left to right in the order they drop.
3. **The speaker carries it.** Full-frame footage, the face clear between the title and the caption; the table covers only the chest.
4. **Loud but simple**: pastel tier labels, near-black rows, one orange title, a yellow item name.

Not a slideshow of rankings (no full-screen cards between takes). Not a countdown (no numbers 5-4-3-2-1). Not a bracket or a versus screen.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Footage**: the user's clip full bleed, 1080 × 1920, untouched.
- **Title**: two lines, italic heavy sans 80 px, skewed −6°, a 22 px glow of the title colour at 35 % and a 3/10 px dark shadow; centred at y 236.
- **Table**: x 140, width 800, from y 1100 (80 px under the caption), padding 5 px on `--latar`, radius 4, a deep shadow (0 30 70 at 50 %). Seven 62 px rows: a 76 px label square in the tier's pastel with a 36 px heavy letter, a `--latar-2` body, a 3 px `--latar` rule between rows; with 3-4 custom tiers on a close-up.
- **Item card**: 580 × 340, radius 6, a 4 px white ring at 85 % plus a deep shadow; ground: a radial gradient from the item's colour (top) to near-black; a 120 px white line icon or 2-3 fanned photos (118 × 148, rotated −9°/0°/+9°) or one photo filling the card; the name in 66-72 px heavy display caps at the bottom (34 px from the edge) in yellow with a 4 px hard shadow.
- **Landed item**: the same card at 0.138 scale (≈ 80 × 47) at the row's left, 128 px apart.
- **Row flash**: a 18 % white layer over the row body, from 90 % to 0 over 0.5 s.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the table frame and row rules; `--latar-2` the row bodies; `--teks` the row flash.
- `--utama` sets the title colour (`--judul-warna`, the brand colour lifted to at least 74 % lightness so it reads on dark footage) and its glow.
- `--aksen` sets the item names (`--nama`, lifted to 84 % lightness: yellow by default).
- Fixed in every brand: the tier pastels S #ff7f7f, A #ffbf7f, B #ffdf7f, C #bfff7f, D #7fbfff, E #8f8fff, F #ff7fff with near-black letters (they are the genre's code), the item colours (blue, purple, teal, amber, rose, from the user or the subject), the near-black card edge, the white ring and icons, the white captions with a dark shadow.

## 4. Type

- `--font-isi` carries the title (italic 800, 80 px, line-height 1.02, −0.01em, skewed −6°; synthesised italic is fine), the tier letters (800, 36 px) and the captions (800, 50 px, lowercase, no punctuation, one line ≤ 16 characters). Inter in the example.
- `--font-judul` carries the item names: Archivo Black 66-72 px, +0.01em, caps, one line ≤ 11 characters (a wider brand font fits fewer; shorten the name, the caption still says it in full).
- Title: 2 lines, 2-3 words each, caps.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Open**: the title drops 30 px and the table rises 40 px, both 0.3 s `power3.out`, at frame 1.
- **Pop**: the card scales 0.5 → 1 from its top-left corner while moving from (+145, +85) to its place, fading in, 0.26 s `back.out(1.7)`, at the name's first frame (or 0.06 s for the first item).
- **Drop**: the card flies to its tier cell and shrinks to (62 − 15) / 340 in 0.34 s `power3.in` (it accelerates into the slot), on the verdict word; the row flashes 0.34 s later and fades over 0.5 s.
- **Captions**: change per group of up to 4 words / 16 characters, cut on 0.04 s before the first word, no pop, no karaoke colour.
- Holds: an item sits popped for 1-1.6 s before its drop; the finished table holds ≥ 2 s at the end.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Static full-frame talking head | an honest opinion, face to face | every beat |
| Card pop over the chest | "now this one" | naming a product, a dish, a tool, a habit |
| Accelerating drop into a row | the verdict is final | ranking, grading, sorting |
| Row flash | it landed, it counts | every drop |
| Two items in the same row | a tie, "this one too" | equal favourites, a recurring winner |
| Finished table held | the full ranking at a glance | the ending, a question to the audience |

## 7. Native moves

- **Pop-and-drop.** Name → big card on the chest; verdict → it falls into its tier. *Fits content like:* a food creator ranking breakfasts; a shop owner ranking delivery couriers; a teacher grading study methods; a gamer ranking levels; a storyteller ranking characters.
- **The rising scoreboard.** The table fills over the video; nothing leaves. *Fits content like:* a series ranking one item per day; a "rate my followers' picks" reel; a product comparison that ends on the winner.
- **Tie in the top tier.** The last item joins the S row beside the first. *Fits content like:* "dua-duanya juara"; two best sellers; two favourite students' projects.
- **Custom tiers.** Replace S-F with 3-4 named tiers (e.g. "WAJIB", "BOLEH", "SKIP") on a close-up. *Fits content like:* a shopping guide; a reading list; a gear checklist.
- **Ask the audience.** The full table holds while the caption asks which one they pick. *Fits content like:* "Kamu tim yang mana?"; "Setuju nggak?"; "Yang mana favoritmu?"

## 8. Pitfalls

- **A card that never lands in time**: keep the video's end at least 0.4 s after the last drop.
- **Captions on the face**: the caption sits 40 px under the chin; on a close-up (chin below about y 1150) use 3-4 tiers so the table stays above y 1500 and shrink the card (≥ 0.6 scale) so it does not dip into the platform's bottom UI.
- **Names that overflow the card**: ≤ 11 characters in the card; the caption can say the full name.
- **Logos and photos the user may not show**: a name card with a line icon is always fine.
- **Too many items**: 1-5 per take; more items, more takes.
- **Performance**: cards are DOM boxes moved by transforms; the glow is a static text-shadow; nothing blurs.

## 9. Using the user's footage

- `<video src="assets/media/upl_….mp4" muted>` (its sound is the voice) at 1080 × 1920 under everything; a landscape clip is reframed to vertical first (craft `reframe.md`), keeping the face in the upper middle.
- Read the chin's y from `inspect_media` frames: caption top = chin + 40, table top = caption + 80.
- Pop and drop times come from the transcript words (`inspect_media` words `{text, start, end}`): pop = the item name's start, drop = the verdict word's start. Captions are the transcript in groups of 4 words / 16 characters.
- No cutout needed: nothing passes behind the speaker.
- 16:9: the speaker sits right of centre (face around x 1300), the table moves to the left (x 120, from y 300) with the title centred above it, the cards pop over the table, and the caption sits under the chin.

# Chest tier list: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.5, medium 3.5, long 5.

## hook

- en: skewed orange two-line title and the S-F table land on frame 1; the first item pops on the chest and drops into S
- id: judul oranye miring dua baris dan tabel S-F masuk di frame pertama; item pertama muncul di dada lalu jatuh ke S

## problem

- en: the worst item pops as it is named and drops hard into D-F on the verdict, the row flashes
- id: item terburuk muncul saat disebut lalu jatuh ke D-F pada putusannya, barisnya berkedip

## fact

- en: one item pops with its photo or icon and holds 1.5 s while the reason is said, then drops into its tier
- id: satu item muncul dengan foto atau ikonnya dan bertahan 1,5 dtk selama alasannya, lalu jatuh ke tiernya

## step

- en: items pop and drop one per sentence, in speaking order; same-tier items line up left to right
- id: item muncul dan jatuh satu per kalimat sesuai urutan bicara; item satu tier berjajar kiri ke kanan

## compare

- en: two items back to back, each popping on its name and dropping into different tiers on their verdicts
- id: dua item berturut-turut, masing-masing muncul pada namanya dan jatuh ke tier berbeda pada putusannya

## number

- en: a card whose name is the number or price, dropping into the tier the speaker gives it
- id: kartu yang namanya angka atau harga, jatuh ke tier yang diberikan pembicara

## proof

- en: the item card with 2-3 fanned photos from the user, held while the proof is said, then dropped
- id: kartu item dengan 2-3 foto pengguna berkipas, bertahan selama buktinya disebut, lalu dijatuhkan

## offer

- en: the user's own product as the last card, dropping into S beside the best, name in yellow caps
- id: produk pengguna sebagai kartu terakhir, jatuh ke S di samping yang terbaik, nama huruf besar kuning

## cta

- en: full table held with the question as the caption under the chin, contact in the last caption, 2 s
- id: tabel lengkap diam dengan pertanyaan sebagai caption di bawah dagu, kontak di caption terakhir, 2 dtk

## payoff

- en: the last item joins its tier, then the finished table holds ≥ 2 s while the speaker asks the audience
- id: item terakhir masuk ke tiernya, lalu tabel lengkap diam ≥ 2 dtk sementara pembicara bertanya ke penonton

<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Tier list di dada</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Archivo Black"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #0b0b0d; --latar-2: #1c1c1e; --utama: #f7931e; --aksen: #ffd93b;
        --teks: #ffffff; --teks-redup: #a1a1aa; --teks-di-utama: #111111; --teks-di-aksen: #111111;
        --utama-di-latar: #f7931e; --aksen-di-latar: #ffd93b;
        --font-judul: "Archivo Black", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Milik gaya ini: warna tier S–F tetap, kartu item gelap berwarna, cincin dan ikon putih, caption putih di atas rekaman.
           Judul dan nama item memakai warna brand yang dinaikkan terangnya supaya terbaca di atas rekaman gelap. */
        --tier-s: #ff7f7f; --tier-a: #ffbf7f; --tier-b: #ffdf7f; --tier-c: #bfff7f; --tier-d: #7fbfff; --tier-e: #8f8fff; --tier-f: #ff7fff; --tier-teks: #111111;
        --i1: #1d4fb8; --i2: #7a2fb0; --i3: #0f766e; --i4: #b45309; --kartu-ujung: #0b0b14; --cincin: #ffffff; --cap-teks: #ffffff; --bayang: #000000;
        --judul-warna: oklch(from var(--utama) max(l, 0.74) c h); --nama: oklch(from var(--aksen) max(l, 0.84) c h);
        /* Rekaman pengganti (ruang dan pembicara): tetap di semua brand, seperti rekaman pengguna yang tidak berubah warna. */
        --f-kayu: #4a2c18; --f-kayu-garis: #24150b; --f-gelap: #1a120c; --f-gelap2: #2e2015; --f-kaca: #1d2629;
        --f-tirai: #e2d7c3; --f-tirai2: #b9ab93; --f-dinding: #5a4330; --f-lampu: #f3cf8e; --f-sofa: #a8977f; --f-sofa2: #857561;
        --f-lantai: #22170f; --f-kulit: #eebd98; --f-kulit2: #c98d68; --f-rambut: #c49a5c; --f-rambut2: #8c6a38; --f-alis: #8a6a40;
        --f-mata: #2b2320; --f-bibir: #c27a68; --f-mulut: #5a2a26; --f-baju: #1a2130; --f-baju2: #252e40; --f-laptop: #c3c1bc;
        --f-laptop2: #8d8b86; --f-kilau: #ffffff;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--f-gelap); font-family: var(--font-isi); color: var(--teks); }
      .klip { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; visibility: hidden; }
      #s1 { visibility: visible; }
      /* Judul oranye miring dua baris dengan pendar. */
      #ttl { position: absolute; text-align: center; font: italic 800 80px/1.02 var(--font-isi); color: var(--judul-warna); letter-spacing: -0.01em; transform: skewX(-6deg); opacity: 0;
        text-shadow: 0 0 22px color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 35%, transparent), 0 3px 10px color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayang) 40%, transparent); }
      /* Tabel tier: bingkai gelap, label berwarna 76 px, baris 62 px. */
      #tb { position: absolute; background: var(--latar); padding: 5px; border-radius: 4px; opacity: 0; box-shadow: 0 30px 70px color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayang) 50%, transparent); }
      .row { position: relative; height: 62px; display: flex; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--latar); }
      .lb { width: 76px; height: 59px; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 800 36px var(--font-isi); color: var(--tier-teks); }
      .rb { flex: 1; background: var(--latar-2); }
      .fl { position: absolute; left: 76px; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 3px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 18%, transparent); opacity: 0; }
      /* Kartu item: muncul di dada saat disebut, lalu jatuh ke barisnya saat putusan. */
      .itm { position: absolute; width: 580px; height: 340px; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0; transform-origin: 0 0;
        background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%, var(--c) 0%, var(--kartu-ujung) 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in oklab, var(--cincin) 85%, transparent), 0 20px 50px color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayang) 50%, transparent); }
      .itm .nm { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 34px; text-align: center; font: 400 66px/1 var(--font-judul); color: var(--nama); letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap;
        text-shadow: 0 4px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayang) 35%, transparent); }
      .itm svg { position: absolute; left: 230px; top: 36px; width: 120px; height: 140px; fill: none; stroke: var(--cincin); stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
      /* Caption tepat di bawah dagu: huruf kecil putih tanpa pelat. */
      .rc { position: absolute; text-align: center; visibility: hidden; font: 800 50px/1 var(--font-isi); color: var(--cap-teks); letter-spacing: -0.01em; white-space: nowrap;
        text-shadow: 0 3px 14px color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayang) 75%, transparent); }
      /* Tata letak 9:16: judul y 236, caption 40 px di bawah dagu (y 1022), tabel di dada dari y 1100. */
      .klip { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; } #ttl { left: 0; width: 1080px; top: 236px; }
    </style>
  </head>

        <div class="itm" id="it3" style="--c: var(--i4)"><svg viewBox="0 0 120 140"><path d="M8 72 H112 Q108 124 60 126 Q12 124 8 72 Z M30 72 L46 36 L62 72 M58 72 L80 30 L96 72 M30 20 Q26 10 34 2" /></svg><div class="nm">LONTONG</div></div>
      </div>
      <div id="caps"></div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const DURASI = 15;
      const TATA = {TX:120, TY:300, TW:800, RH:62, IX:230, IY:330, CX:900, CW:800, CY:610}; // posisi tabel (TX, TY), lebar (TW), baris (RH), kartu muncul (IX, IY), caption (CX, CW, CY)
      // Naskah contoh [mulai, selesai, kalimat]; rekaman asli memakai kata bertimestamp dari transkrip inspect_media.
      const UCAPAN = [
        [0.15, 1.4, "Nasi uduk?"], [1.6, 3.9, "Ini jelas kelas S, nggak ada lawan."],
        [4.5, 6.1, "Bubur ayam, enak, tapi kelas A."], [6.5, 7.4, "Roti bakar?"], [7.6, 9.4, "Kelas C aja, cepat bosan."],
        [10.0, 11.0, "Lontong sayur?"], [11.2, 12.4, "Kelas S juga."], [12.9, 14.6, "Kamu tim yang mana?"],
      ];
      function kata(lines) {
        const out = [];
        for (const [s, e, txt] of lines) {
          const ws = txt.split(" "), tot = ws.reduce((a, w) => a + w.length + 2, 0);
          let t = s;
          for (const w of ws) { const d = ((e - s) * (w.length + 2)) / tot; out.push({ w, s: t, e: t + d * 0.92 }); t += d; }
        }
        return out;
      }
      const KATA = kata(UCAPAN);
      const bersih = (w) => w.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}'-]/gu, "");
      // Grup caption: paling banyak maxw kata dan maxc huruf, putus di tanda baca (seperti caption pendek media sosial).
      function grup(maxw, maxc) {
        const g = []; let cur = [];
        for (const k of KATA) {
          const b = bersih(k.w);
          if (cur.length && (cur.length >= maxw || [...cur.map((c) => c.b), b].join(" ").length > maxc)) { g.push(cur); cur = []; }
          cur.push({ ...k, b });
          if (/[.,?!]$/.test(k.w)) { g.push(cur); cur = []; }
        }
        if (cur.length) g.push(cur);
        return g;
      }
      const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
      const kepala = $("kepala"), mata = $("mata"), bibir = $("bibir"), rongga = $("rongga"), tka = $("tka"), tki = $("tki");
      const KEDIP = [1.2, 3.9, 6.1, 8.8, 11.3, 13.7];
      const hidup = { t: 0 };
      tl.to(hidup, { t: DURASI, duration: DURASI, ease: "none", onUpdate: () => {
        const t = hidup.t;
        let o = 0;
        for (const k of KATA) if (t >= k.s && t < k.e) o = Math.sin(((t - k.s) / (k.e - k.s)) * Math.PI) * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.abs(Math.sin(k.s * 7.3)));
        rongga.setAttribute("ry", (2 + 15 * o).toFixed(1));
        bibir.setAttribute("ry", (10 + 6 * o).toFixed(1));
        const b = KEDIP.some((x) => t > x && t < x + 0.14) ? 0.1 : 1;
        mata.setAttribute("transform", "translate(0 744) scale(1 " + b + ") translate(0 -744)");
        const a = 1.8 * Math.sin(t * 1.7) + 0.9 * Math.sin(t * 3.1), dy = 5 * Math.sin(t * 2.3);
        kepala.setAttribute("transform", "rotate(" + a.toFixed(2) + " 540 960) translate(0 " + dy.toFixed(1) + ")");
        const g = Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 1.25)), h = Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 1.25 + 2.2));
        tka.setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + (300 + 30 * h).toFixed(1) + " " + (1350 - 130 * g).toFixed(1) + ") rotate(" + (-14 + 18 * g).toFixed(1) + ") scale(1.3)");
        tki.setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + (780 - 30 * g).toFixed(1) + " " + (1350 - 130 * h).toFixed(1) + ") rotate(" + (14 - 18 * h).toFixed(1) + ") scale(1.3)");
      } }, 0);
      const T = (w, n = 1) => KATA.filter((k) => bersih(k.w) === w)[n - 1].s; // waktu sebuah kata, seperti jangkar kata di naskah
      const { TX, TY, TW, RH, IX, IY, CX, CW, CY } = TATA;

      // Caption: satu baris paling banyak 16 huruf, huruf kecil, muncul dari kata pertama sampai grup berikutnya.
      const G = grup(4, 16), caps = $("caps");
      G.forEach((g, i) => {
        const d = document.createElement("div");
        d.className = "rc"; d.textContent = g.map((k) => k.b).join(" ");
        d.style.cssText = "left: " + CX + "px; width: " + CW + "px; top: " + CY + "px";
        caps.appendChild(d);
        tl.set(d, { visibility: "visible" }, Math.max(0, g[0].s - 0.04)).set(d, { visibility: "hidden" }, i + 1 < G.length ? G[i + 1][0].s - 0.04 : DURASI);
      });

      // Tabel S–F dan judul masuk bersama pada frame pertama.
      const TIER = ["s", "a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"];
      $("tb").style.cssText = "left: " + TX + "px; top: " + TY + "px; width: " + TW + "px";
      $("tb").innerHTML = TIER.map((t) => '<div class="row" id="row' + t + '"><div class="lb" style="background: var(--tier-' + t + ')">' + t.toUpperCase() + '</div><div class="rb"></div><div class="fl"></div></div>').join("");
      tl.fromTo("#ttl", { y: -30 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "power3.out" }, 0);
      tl.fromTo("#tb", { y: 40 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "power3.out" }, 0);

      // Item: muncul pada namanya (skala 0,5 → 1, back.out), jatuh ke barisnya pada putusan (0,34 dtk power3.in), baris berkedip.
      const terpakai = {};
      const item = (n, tier, pop, drop) => {
        const k = (terpakai[tier] = (terpakai[tier] ?? -1) + 1), i = TIER.indexOf(tier);
        const sx = TX + 5 + 76 + 8 + k * 128, sy = TY + 5 + i * RH + 6;
        tl.set("#it" + n, { left: IX, top: IY }, 0);
        tl.fromTo("#it" + n, { scale: 0.5, x: 145, y: 85 }, { scale: 1, x: 0, y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.26, ease: "back.out(1.7)" }, pop);
        tl.to("#it" + n, { x: sx - IX, y: sy - IY, scale: (RH - 15) / 340, duration: 0.34, ease: "power3.in" }, drop);
        tl.fromTo("#row" + tier + " .fl", { opacity: 0.9 }, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, immediateRender: false }, drop + 0.34);
      };
      item(0, "s", 0.06, T("s"));
      tl.set("#s2", { visibility: "visible" }, 4.4);
      item(1, "a", T("bubur"), T("a"));
      item(2, "c", T("roti"), T("c"));
      tl.set("#s3", { visibility: "visible" }, 9.8);
      item(3, "s", T("lontong"), T("s", 2));

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
